summary.title: New Dosing Modes: Open Loop, LGS, Basal Test
changes: A Dosing Mode picker replaces the Closed Loop toggle with Closed Loop, Open Loop, Low Glucose Suspend, and Basal Test.
Open Loop now shows forecasts and updates COB and IOB, and the treatment view works correctly.
Low Glucose Suspend mode can only lower or stop basal insulin and will not give corrective increases.
Basal Testing mode prevents routine adjustments except for low-glucose suspend and pins sensitivity so you can measure.
Switching modes does not change your saved settings and switching back restores your original preferences.
